question: Introducing a girl to his son-in-law, Bhola said, "Her brother is the only son of my brother-in-law." How is the girl related to Bhola?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8f4ee4534eea80969d7fb51913847c35b53b29bd5fe2bd7b9a9cbeea087636a.png] 

The family tree are given below -

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9f9e0a29d6cf5615d93f19050c9b8665b83393b1682c964b54aaaac5b99d7ed.png] 

 

Girl is the niece of Bhola.

Hence, **"Niece" **is the correct answer.
